_about: ONE stale-handle repair rule, read by BOTH app/src/components/chart/engine/__tests__/staleHandleParity.test.js (memberDocumentMigration.migrateMemberDocument) and tests/test_stale_handle_parity.py (user_definitions.refresh_stale_handle). Each case starts from `base` (a Clouds document origin/master's door saved with both lengths edited: its compute.fn is the UNEDITED tree's hash) and applies `transform`; `repaired` says whether compute.fn must become the hash of compute.ast (`expectFn`), or stay exactly as given.

cases.name: a param-edited document with a stale handle
no parameter manifest: not a param edit
trees disagree with treesHash: not self-consistent
